import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def raw_insert : BinarySearchTree → Int → BinarySearchTree
| BinarySearchTree.Empty, v =>
    BinarySearchTree.Node v BinarySearchTree.Empty BinarySearchTree.Empty
| BinarySearchTree.Node x l r, v =>
    if v < x then
      BinarySearchTree.Node x (raw_insert l v) r
    else if v > x then
      BinarySearchTree.Node x l (raw_insert r v)
    else
      BinarySearchTree.Node x l r
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def insert (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t v) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let _h : insert_precond t v := h_precond
  raw_insert t v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : insert_precond t v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∪ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem raw_insert_view (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) :
    view (raw_insert t v) = view t ∪ {v} := by
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      ext y
      simp [raw_insert, view]
  | Node x l r ihl ihr =>
      by_cases hlt : v < x
      · ext y
        constructor <;> intro hy <;>
          simp only [raw_insert, hlt, if_true, view, ihl, Set.mem_union,
            Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy ⊢ <;>
          tauto
      · by_cases hgt : v > x
        · ext y
          constructor <;> intro hy <;>
            simp only [raw_insert, hlt, if_false, hgt, if_true, view, ihr,
              Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy ⊢ <;>
            tauto
        · have hvx : v = x := by omega
          subst v
          have hxlt : ¬ x < x := by omega
          have hxgt : ¬ x > x := by omega
          ext y
          constructor <;> intro hy <;>
            simp only [raw_insert, hxlt, if_false, hxgt, view, Set.mem_union,
              Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy ⊢ <;>
            tauto

theorem raw_insert_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) (h : is_bst t) :
    is_bst (raw_insert t v) := by
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      simp [raw_insert, is_bst, view]
  | Node x l r ihl ihr =>
      change
        (∀ y ∈ view l, y < x) ∧
        is_bst l ∧
        (∀ y ∈ view r, y > x) ∧
        is_bst r at h
      rcases h with ⟨hl_lt, hl_bst, hr_gt, hr_bst⟩
      by_cases hlt : v < x
      · have hleft_bound : ∀ y ∈ view (raw_insert l v), y < x := by
          intro y hy
          have hy' : y ∈ view l ∪ ({v} : Set Int) := by
            simpa [raw_insert_view l v] using hy
          rcases hy' with hy_l | hy_v
          · exact hl_lt y hy_l
          · have hy_eq : y = v := by simpa using hy_v
            omega
        have hres : is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node x (raw_insert l v) r) :=
          ⟨hleft_bound, ihl hl_bst, hr_gt, hr_bst⟩
        simpa [raw_insert, hlt] using hres
      · by_cases hgt : v > x
        · have hright_bound : ∀ y ∈ view (raw_insert r v), y > x := by
            intro y hy
            have hy' : y ∈ view r ∪ ({v} : Set Int) := by
              simpa [raw_insert_view r v] using hy
            rcases hy' with hy_r | hy_v
            · exact hr_gt y hy_r
            · have hy_eq : y = v := by simpa using hy_v
              omega
          have hres : is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node x l (raw_insert r v)) :=
            ⟨hl_lt, hl_bst, hright_bound, ihr hr_bst⟩
          simpa [raw_insert, hlt, hgt] using hres
        · have hres : is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) :=
            ⟨hl_lt, hl_bst, hr_gt, hr_bst⟩
          simpa [raw_insert, hlt, hgt] using hres
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem insert_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t v) :
    insert_postcond t v (insert t v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  change is_bst (raw_insert t v) ∧ view (raw_insert t v) = view t ∪ {v}
  exact ⟨raw_insert_bst t v h_precond, raw_insert_view t v⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
